_note: Site-wide config a staffer can edit without touching HTML. `admission` drives the reusable 'At the Gate' block (js/components.js → initGate) on the homepage, fixtures and contact pages.

admission.heading: At the Gate
admission.sub: Pay on the day — cash or card accepted

seasonTicket.excludes: Not valid for FA competitions — the Emirates FA Cup & Isuzu FA Vase

_kitNote: The colours the club plays in. Required in the matchday programme by the League's published minimum ('the colours in which the teams will play') and, until this was added, absent from it entirely. Stored ONCE here so no programme editor ever retypes the club's own kit; the opposition's colours are confirmed per edition. `hex` is only for drawing the little kit strip — `name` is what prints.
_kitCorrection: The home kit is YELLOW / YELLOW / YELLOW. It was briefly recorded here with green shorts, which was wrong and was corrected by the club. The goalkeeper colours are NOT recorded because the club has not confirmed them — that field stays null and the programme prints 'To be confirmed'. An invented goalkeeper colour is exactly the kind of plausible detail that reaches print unchallenged, so it is left empty on purpose. Away colours are unconfirmed for the same reason.

gameDay._note: KILL SWITCH. Set enabled:false to turn game-day homepage theming off everywhere, immediately, without a deploy — data/config.json is fetched at runtime. The homepage falls back to the normal Rayners Lane theme. js/game-day.js checks this BEFORE doing any other work, and any error anywhere in that file also tears the theme down, because a cosmetic feature must never be able to break the club front page on a matchday.
